feedback: Create a "floaty chasm" variant of this platformer: low-gravity, long hang-time jumps over a lava-heavy, vertical world.  Movement constants near the top of the file: - GRAVITY: 0.5 -> 0.25   (floaty, long hang time) - JUMP_FORCE: -8 -> -6   (softer launch; low gravity keeps the arc high and long) - SPEED: 4 -> 3          (slower, drifting pace)  World generation, inside generateLevel: - Lava pits more common: isPit chance 0.3 -> 0.5  (rng() < 0.5) - Wider gaps: pitWidth 2-4 tiles -> 3-4 tiles     (Math.floor(rng()*2) + 3) - More vertical terrain: dy step -2..+2 -> -3..+3  (Math.floor(rng()*7) - 3)

selection.reason: Modify gravity and jump constants in prelude for floaty movement, and adjust level generation parameters in generateLevel for more lava and verticality.
